I work mainly in financial analytics space, on projects of varying complexity. I have pitched to teams at large software enterprises, investment banks, asset managers, hedge funds and private equity firms, as well as small early-stage startups. Clients have ranged from SaaS and payments companies to institutions across all major asset classes.

Each page in the **Projects** menu on the left is a project proposal. It sets out the problem, my approach and my plan for delivery, which I created.
